Subject: OVR-577

Subject: OVR-578
Why: Provider rglob over 144k entries took 15 s per frame on image-riposte; replaced with os.walk pruning skip and dot directories plus an mtime cache (1.2 s cold, 0.7 s warm).

Subject: OVR-591
Question: how users get the pacer CLI

Why: one command on PATH; nothing to build per project

Subject: OVR-613
Question: Where does a project's PACER state live?
Chosen: .pacer/: project.pacer.toml, five registers, ledger, archive/, untracked run/
Rejected: registers in the project root; state outside the repository
Why: Root files cluttered every project and put a multi-megabyte ledger in every search. A dot-directory is where hosts keep per-project files, and it can carry its own ignore and attributes files.

Subject: OVR-613
Why: With core.autocrlf on, a checkout rewrote every register to CRLF and the next PACER write rewrote them all back. .pacer/.gitattributes sets -text.

Subject: OVR-577;OVR-583;OVR-612
Question: How do hooks start?
Chosen: standard-library runtime started by file path; uv only picks the interpreter
Rejected: a uv project environment per plugin version; a compiled launcher
Why: A hook runs on every edit. This takes 0.19 s with no first-call build. Only the MCP server keeps a dependency. A test fails on any third-party import outside it.

Subject: OVR-108;OVR-609

Rejected: the portable root plugin.json with extensions.com.openai

Subject: OVR-583

Subject: OVR-601
Question: How is PACER installed?
Chosen: one standard-library install.py that leaves exactly one copy per host
Rejected: PowerShell and shell installers kept in step; documentation only
Why: Three installers in two languages had diverged, and hosts keep an earlier copy unless it is removed. A reinstall is forced because hosts skip a plugin whose version is unchanged.

Subject: OVR-050;OVR-578

Subject: OVR-157;OVR-012
Why: The repository's tooling generates nothing inside plugins/pacer: hosts copy it verbatim or run it in place. The environment sits in .venv at the repository root and caches under .cache, set by check.py.

Subject: OVR-574

Subject: OVR-635
Question: Where does the latest version come from?
Chosen: the v* tags on the origin, read with git ls-remote and the credentials git already has
Rejected: the GitHub releases API; a version file over HTTPS
Why: Works on any git host and a private repository without a token. The check runs with every prompt disabled so it can only fail quietly. A release is exactly a tag; release.py is the only thing that makes one.

Subject: OVR-635;OVR-577
Question: How is a new version announced?
Chosen: once per version: a terminal after a pacer command, or session start through systemMessage; silence stops the check too
Rejected: every run, like pip; once per channel
Why: The person asked for once. systemMessage reaches the person and never the model, so no session pays context for it.

Subject: OVR-634
Question: How is the pacer command installed?
Chosen: an editable uv tool that runs the source; its environment is rebuilt only when version, interpreter or dependencies change
Rejected: a built tool reinstalled on every update
Why: Measured: uv cannot replace pacer.exe while a pacer process runs, which is pacer update itself. An editable launcher never needs replacing.

Subject: OVR-634
Question: When is a host reinstalled?
Chosen: when its installed copy differs from the source file by file, is missing, or is duplicated
Why: Hosts refresh nothing on their own and version strings do not change between edits. Comparing bytes makes update, --check and --status exact.

Subject: OVR-631;OVR-630
Question: How does a long operation show progress?
Chosen: the Pace Line: one segmented line sized by stage durations learned from the last run, a lantern, a glint; live, plain, events
Why: No dependency on the hook path; proportional segments move at an even pace; the events form lets the old update render the new installer.

Subject: OVR-634

Subject: OVR-635

Subject: OVR-627;OVR-628
Question: How is the MIVIM hierarchy carried?
Chosen: MIVIM.pipeline declares it; pacer.identity repeats it; a test holds them together; displays sign with it; the home is mivim/pacer
Rejected: parsing the pipeline file at runtime
Why: The file's syntax is the organisation's, not PACER's; constants checked against it are stable and cheap, and the home namespace leaves room beside PACER for later MIVIM tools.
